by the Appellant on or about January 14, 2026. The Appellant was thereafter notified that the
Petition as filed was deficient and was given a reasonable time to bring the Petition into compliance. At the
passage of that time with no response from the Appellant. this Board entered an Order to Show Cause
why this matter should not be dismissed for failure to bring the Petition into compliance with the
statutes and regulations. No timely response was received to the Show Cause Order.

Based on the foregoing, and being otherwise sufficiently advised. the matter is HEREBY

COMMONWEALTH OF KENTUCKY
PUBLIC PROTECTION CABINET
KENTUCKY BOARD OF TAX APPEALS

EXETER 3524 PRESTON LLC,
Appellant,
v.

ASSESSMENT APPEALS and

BULLITT COUNTY PROPERTY
VALUATION ADMINISTRATOR,

Nee Ne See ee ee” ee ee ee es ee Se

Appellees.

AGREED ORDER OF DISMISSAL

The Board of Tax Appeals having been informed of an agreement between the parties
which fully and completely resolves all issues between them in the above-styled action, and being
otherwise sufficiently advised,

IT IS HEREBY ORDERED:

1. The Property subject to this appeal — Lot 1 of the property located at 3524 South Preston
Highway, Shepherdsville, Kentucky 40165, identified by the Bullitt County Property
Valuation Administrator as Parcel] Number 047-000-00-012E (the “Property”) — shall be
assessed at the fair cash value of $0 for the 2024 tax year.

2. The land and improvements comprising the Property were previously assessed for the
January 1, 2024, assessment date as part of Parcel Number 047-000-00-012, which was
assessed at a fair cash value of $60,268,000 for the 2024 tax year and as to which 2024
property tax has been imposed and paid in full. That assessment of Parcel Number 047-
000-00-012 was not challenged on this Appeal and is not affected by this Agreed Order.

3. The Bullitt County Property Valuation Administrator will take the necessary steps to adjust
its records to reflect the $0 valuation of the Property for the 2024 tax year.

4. This Agreed Order does not contain any admission, concession, or agreement by either
Party concerning the merits of any issue of fact or law with respect to the assessment of
the Property for the 2024 tax year. This Agreed Order shall not be construed as constituting
or containing any such admission, concession, or agreement.

5. This Agreed Order having resolved all issues between the parties, this appeal is
DISMISSED with prejudice and all future hearing dates are VACATED. Each party to

bear its own costs.
